snippet.title: PAC-MAN CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2007 - PC Longplay
snippet.description:
I’ve been dying to do this for so long, and now here it is!! My longplay video of 
PAC-MAN CHAMPIONSHIP EDITION 2007!!!
This is an Android version but I’m playing it on the PC! And here are all the stages for this game too! Also this game on the PC was lagging a bit but not to worry about that. Best gameplay ever! I sure hope you enjoy this longplay video! If you are, then leave it a BIG LIKE! Enjoy the video and subscribe to my channel now!

Platforms: PlayStation Portable, Android, iOS, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, Java, Nintendo 3DS, Maemo

System: PC - Windows 10

YouTube: Subscribe now!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC34EoPZgDEZsSA2i_
